summary: Switch-based property setter on a DWORD array object. Dispatches on the selector argument (result) through jump table jpt_44F6F9 and writes the incoming value a6 to one of four array elements. Cases 0, 1, 2 write elements 44, 45, 46 directly; case 3 accumulates into element 47. Called by ByteBufferAccumulator (0x0044F5E2), indicating a byte-buffer-driven UI property update path.

operations.description: Dispatch on the selector argument (result) via jump table jpt_44F6F9; cases 0-3 select which property element to write.
Case 0: write incoming value a6 to element a2[44].
Case 1: write incoming value a6 to element a2[45].
Case 2: write incoming value a6 to element a2[46].
Case 3: accumulate incoming value a6 into element a2[47] (a2[47] = a2[47] + a6) and update the return value to the new sum.
Return incoming value a6 for cases 0 and 2 (and implicitly case 1), or the accumulated sum for case 3.
Context: this setter is invoked by ByteBufferAccumulator at 0x0044F5E2, consistent with a byte-buffer-driven UI property update path.
